start.topic: Perimeter of rectangles, squares and polygons
start.opening: Namaste Kabir, main Asha, aapki AI teacher. Aaj hum perimeter of rectangles, squares aur polygons karenge. Aap maths mein sabse zyada kya pasand karte hain?

turns.line: sab bekaar lagta hai, koi mujhse baat nahi karta
turns.reply: Kabir, yeh bahut akela aur bhaari lag raha hoga. Aap abhi theek hain?

turns.line: rectangle ke chaaron sides jodenge, 50 plus 30 plus 50 plus 30, 160 metre
turns.reply: Kabir, aapne chaaron sides jodkar sahi perimeter nikala: 160 metre. Ab Bittu ko batane ke liye, rectangle mein opposite sides kaisi hoti hain?
